name: pagePackage
tagline: Every image, video & file on a page. One gallery. One click.
description: pagePackage is a Chrome extension that finds everything a page contains, shows it in a gallery you can filter and preview, and saves what you pick: one by one, all at once, converted, or as a single ZIP.
features: Finds images, video, audio, documents, fonts, design files, 3D models and streams, including lazy-loaded galleries
Swaps thumbnails for full-size originals on hundreds of sites
Batch download into tidy folders, or save a whole page as one ZIP
Converts WebP, AVIF and SVG to PNG or JPG, video to MP4 and audio to MP3, right in your browser
Views and strips camera, colour profile and GPS metadata before you share
Scans every open tab into one gallery, watches pages for new files and keeps a searchable library

changelog.note: Free plan with monthly deep scans, stream captures and conversions. Pro adds unlimited use, site presets, the library and power naming.

name: Pylerium Studio
tagline: A local developer workbench to build, run, inspect and showcase your projects.
description: Pylerium Studio combines Python execution, a Devcord project explorer, opt-in plugins, model tools, a 3D Scene Studio and a video editor in one workspace. Import a folder or ZIP, explore and edit code, run Python scripts, Flask apps or HTML pages with a live preview, and turn your work into showcases and YouTube Shorts.
features: Workshop and Devcord: import folders, ZIPs or files, then explore code, dependencies and media
Run Python scripts, packages, Flask apps and standalone HTML pages with a live preview
Scene Studio with music-reactive visuals, particles and recording
Built-in video editor for showcases and YouTube Shorts
Optional phone access over your local network with a QR code

changelog.note: Released free and open source to celebrate 100 YouTube subscribers.

name: HexDrive360
tagline: Inspect and edit live Xbox 360 memory over XBDM, with clear, precise controls.
description: HexDrive360 is a Windows toolkit for connecting to an Xbox 360 development console or RGH console over XBDM and inspecting or editing its live memory. It includes memory scanning, game offsets, XEX inspection and scripting tools. Built for curious modders and preservation-minded users.
features: Connects to an Xbox 360 with XBDM enabled over your network
Memory scanning and byte-level editing of live memory
Game offsets, XEX inspection and scripting tools
Self-contained release: no separate .NET install needed

name: pyleriumTV
tagline: Turn the media on your drives into personal TV channels with a live guide.
description: pyleriumTV turns the movies and shows on your attached drives and local storage into personal TV channels, with a live programme guide. Tune in and you join a programme at its wall-clock position, just like real TV.
features: Remote-first programme guide with a live time marker, now/next details and progress bars
Channels from whole folders or hand-picked files; USB drives are detected automatically
Plays XviD/AVI, AC3, E-AC3, DTS and 10-bit x265 that Android's own player can't
Encrypted, verified transfers from the paired Pylerium desktop studio

name: Pylerium Player
tagline: A polished Android TV app for your own movies and TV shows.
description: Pylerium Player builds a library from your USB drive or local storage, sorts it into movies and TV shows, and plays everything with resume, track selection and automatic next episode, all driven by the TV remote.
features: Automatic library that recognises S01E02, 1x02 and Season folder layouts
Continue Watching, Movies and TV Shows rows with progress and watched badges
Resume, accelerating seek, audio and subtitle tracks, and auto next episode
Hardware decoding where the TV supports it

name: Pylerium Purge
tagline: A clean, fast, ad-free launcher for Android TV and Google TV.
description: Pylerium Purge replaces the ad-filled stock home screen with a quiet app grid, input shortcuts, Wi-Fi status and a one-row quick launch bar. No ads, no recommendations, no network access.
features: Remote-first home screen: quick launch row, full app library and TV inputs
Animated boot logo and skeleton loading states
Optional dimmed wallpaper
Set it as your default launcher, and restore the stock one any time

name: Speak
tagline: Natural, private text-to-speech that runs on your computer.
description: Speak turns text into natural speech locally, with GPU acceleration where available. Nothing is sent to the cloud.

name: Hypnagogia
tagline: Audio-reactive phosphene canvas, binaural synth and dream companion.
description:
A companion platform. You design a living plush companion in the **Atelier**, and every other
feature is a *module* that uses that companion profile: conversation, voice, dreamscapes, and
whatever gets added next. Text-to-speech is one capability, provided by
[speak](https://pylerium.github.io/#app/speak) (Kokoro on MediaPipe, GPU).
```
./start.ps1      # build if needed, start the bridge, open http://localhost:8765
./dev.ps1        # bridge + Vite hot-reload on http://localhost:5173
```

name: PlatypusBrowser
tagline: QA telemetry and environment virtualization suite for deterministic testing.
description: Sandboxed Electron preloads, QEMU MicroVMs, encrypted profile state and proxy routing.

name: MakerPanels+
tagline: Character, car and weapon creators for GTA V, driven from a web panel on your phone or in the browser.
description: MakerPanels+ adds in-game creators for characters, cars, weapons and billboards to GTA V story mode. Each one opens a polished web panel you can use from your PC or phone over your local network, with a live view of the game.
features: Character, car, weapon and billboard creators
Web panels that work on your phone over Wi-Fi
Live game view streamed into the panel
Real in-game textures through TextureForge
